map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: "ror2 when"

map_mission1.Dialogue: The flames roar to life - and a voice speaks out. "Another life, well returned!"
map_mission1.Name: Mission
map_mission1.Description: "My Candles tell me tales,#&y&Undead&!& form and blossom#Find their abode and knock,#And free them from their jails." ##The flames never spoke in prose.

map_zombie.Name: Undead
map_zombie.Description: The fire licks and sneers. Undead, zombies included, must be helped towards the afterlife.

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: Undead are easiest to kill when alone.

map_mission2.Name: Mission
map_mission2.Description: "The undead begin to crop#strange &b&powders&!& from below.#Incite the flame -#eject their brains!#And see what it contains."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: There's a &y&bouncer&!& on the far side of the house. I can kill him to get his weapon.

map_bouncer.Name: bouncer
map_bouncer.Description: Large zombies with shotguns. Takes a few shots to the head to bring them down.

map_drugs.Name: powders
map_drugs.Description: A new drug called "ash." His candles say that it makes you feel like you're alive again. The flames - my employer - want to know more.

map_mission3.Dialogue: The flames roar to life - and I see visions inside.
map_mission3.Name: Mission
map_mission3.Description: The fireplace began to speak, #"Flesh caskets breathe.#Burn the ash,#scatter their teeth."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: I see two entrances to the house. The left entrance has less zombies, but the right entrance has more weapons. My choice.

map_dock.Name: docks
map_dock.Description: Charon lives at the docks - I can exchange souls for weapons before I accept my mission.

map_gun.Name: New Gun
map_gun.Description: I see visions of Charon, the Ferryman. He may be interested in the souls I have collected for our mutual employer - I should see him at the &y&docks&!& before my next mission.

map_mission4.Dialogue: The flames roar to life - and you see visions of a man, Puff.
map_mission4.Name: Mission
map_mission4.Description: "No moment to flee -# he should not be here.#&y&A man with a heart&!&,#cannot live with me."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: The Candles tell me that Puff keeps an old machine gun in his basement - something he stole from the Trideads. I am sure it still works.

map_puff.Name: Puff
map_puff.Description: Shadows cast along the wall, and the flames show me silhouettes of Puff's death.##This is the first time my employer has given me a specific target - and I succumb to the thrill.

map_mission5.Dialogue: The flames roar to life, with more vigor than usual. My employer is happy with success.
map_mission5.Name: Mission
map_mission5.Description: "Hellhounds from beneath, #bred by the undead.#Go stop the weeping, #and gnashing of teeth."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: Hellhounds are three headed dogs with amazing sense of hearing, but they can't open doors. I'll use that to my advantage.

map_mission6.Dialogue: The flames roar to life - and I see visions inside.
map_mission6.Name: Mission
map_mission6.Description: "My &y&Candle&!& has searched,#but never returned." ##The second address is familiar to the fireplace - I'll find what happened to the Candle.

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: The zombies have hung up security cameras. They don't do much, but will scream if it sees me for too long. I'll avoid them, or shoot them down.

map_reaper.Name: Candle
map_reaper.Description: Candles are the eyes and ears of the flames, always observing and bringing information.

map_mission7.Name: Mission
map_mission7.Description: The Zombie Kingz have become scared of my hunt. They have begun heavily guarding a nearby motel - I will find what they are hiding.

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: The Candles tell me that Zombie Kingz patrols are nearby. I'll have to be quick, in case there are reinforcements.

map_lamp.Name: Lamp
map_lamp.Description: "A man of light," spoke the fireplace, "should not have to spend his time in darkness."

map_mission8.Dialogue: The flames roar to life - and I see visions inside.
map_mission8.Name: Mission
map_mission8.Description: "Their location - explained!#Burn the ash, #burn the dead,#and free souls contained."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: My mission is to destroy all the ash - but it is best if I focus on killing the undead first.

map_mission9.Dialogue: The flames roar to life - and I see blood inside.
map_mission9.Name: Mission
map_mission9.Description: "Attempting to lead,#his creed to salvation.#&y&A man with ambition&!&,#cannot live with me."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: Roland's house is filled with many guards - but the only target is Roland. I'll separate him from his men.

map_roland.Name: Roland
map_roland.Description: His death will shatter the Zombie Kingz leadership - I must remember that the mission is to kill Roland, not the others.

map_mission10.Name: Mission
map_mission10.Description: "Pale moonlight. #Touch -  no heat. #&b&Vampires&!& flock, #find out why."

map_vamp.Name: Vampires
map_vamp.Description: Tall undead, said to be formed by betrayal from a lover. They are much more dangerous than zombies - I'll have to make sure that every shot counts.

map_mirror.Name: Mirror
map_mirror.Description: "Look upon your reflection," said the fireplace, "and remember that you are different. You are not undead."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: Dancing vampires won't notice your presence - unless you shoot them.

map_mission11.Name: Mission
map_mission11.Description: "More, more, so many more. #So many corpses, #who forgot to die."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: Shotgun weapons are strongest near doors and entryways, where enemies can't react until it's too late.

map_mission12.Name: Mission
map_mission12.Description: "The vampires reform - #a lounge not too far. #Discover their aim, #and bring them a storm."##This lounge contains a safe - maybe I can understand why these clubs have been suddenly appearing.

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: Some vampires have their souls outside of their body, stored in &y&phylacteries&!&. They must be destroyed to kill the vampire.

map_bottle.Name: phylactery
map_bottle.Description: Magical charms - the vampires prefer bottles. They will glow noticeably blue.

map_mission13.Name: Mission
map_mission13.Description: Candles have spotted vampires coming and going from the industrial district - the same address I found in the safe. I'll find out what they're doing. ##Suddenly, the flames speak: "The goals of undead are always the same."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: Some vampires will have phylacteries in difficult places, and will have to be killed multiple times.

map_cat.Name: Cat
map_cat.Description: "I... thought you could use companionship," spoke the fireplace. "Life is not meant to be spent alone."

map_mission14.Name: Mission
map_mission14.Description: "&b&Twins&!& lost at sea - #of lust and of pain. #Women without love, #cannot live with me."

map_twins.Name: Twins

map_brothel.Name: brothels
map_brothel.Description: The vampires are both the most attractive and sexually active undead, so it comes naturally.

map_twins.Description: Amber and Evelyn run &y&brothels&!& downtown. They are high ranking members of the 1000 Year Royals - they must understand the cryptic messages I've been finding in the club safes.

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: The twins have somehow made each other their phylactery. I will have to kill both at nearly the same time.

map_mission15.Name: Mission
map_mission15.Description: A club the Candles have been investigating has suddenly gone quiet - along with the Candles. What happened inside?

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: There is no intel. The fireplace remains quiet.

map_mission16.Name: Mission
map_mission16.Description: The undead have somehow been turning their own bodies into ash... is that the purpose of all these clubs? &y&Sir&!& &y&Stela&!&, the head of the 1000 Year Royals, most likely knows how this was done.##"He will know the key,#betrayal of kin.#A man without guilt,#cannot live with me."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: Sir Stela's private condominium is heavily guarded, so expect heavy opposition.

map_stela.Name: Sir Stela
map_stela.Description: The Stelas are a royal family of vampires. Any activity in the 1000 Year Royals would not go without them knowing.

map_mission17.Name: Mission
map_mission17.Description: "Skeletons are found, #no flesh and no love.#Stop their harvest -#or &y&Ibzan&!& is crowned.

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: By the time I arrived, the harvest will be near complete. I'll only have a minute to destroy all the harvest totems.

map_ibzan.Name: Ibzan
map_ibzan.Description: "His heart long gone, #Ibzan leads The Dredged.#You must bring his end - #he cannot do it alone."

map_mission18.Name: Mission
map_mission18.Description: "No forest - a lone tree.#Kills her own for escape.#A woman without guilt,#cannot live with me."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: The Candles have reported Madam Stela has multiple phylacteries - I will have to destroy them all before taking Madam Stela down.

map_mission19.Name: Mission
map_mission19.Description: "Candles do not know,#the &y&skeletons'&!& aim. #Go and peer inside, #their precious cargo."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: While the Candles couldn't see inside the cargo, they did spot a crane with a weapon on top.

map_skeleton.Name: skeletons
map_skeleton.Description: Those who take their own life come back as skeletons, destined forever to roam this Place.

map_mission20.Name: Mission
map_mission20.Description: "They climb to the sky,#scouting for reapers.#Do not let them build - #they will fly too high."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: Technicians plant mines when spooked - but the mines can be used against them.

map_mission21.Name: Mission
map_mission21.Description: "&y&Generals&!&, unchained!# Corpses to surface. #Find those who have drowned,#and drown them again."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: There is no reply, but the flames continues to crackle.

map_general.Name: Generals
map_general.Description: Commonly known as lich, Generals have the ability to bring damaged skeletons back to life. The source of this power is unknown, even to the Candles.

map_mission22.Name: Mission
map_mission22.Description: "Around Ibzan - coils,#undead forgotten.#Open their coffins, #uncover their spoils."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: The Candles have found the location of all the skeletons' shipping containers - but many skeletons guard the location. Kill the Generals first, or draw them to a trap by killing nearby skeletons.

map_mission23.Name: Mission
map_mission23.Description: "&y&Timur&!& is free.#Knows purpose of flesh.#A man with desire,#cannot live with me."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: There is no reply, but the flames continues to crackle.

map_temur.Name: Timur
map_temur.Description: "Timur is the chief engineer for The Dredged. His crafting skills are only matched by his paranoia - his lab is outfitted with traps. I will have to tread carefully.

map_mission24.Name: Mission
map_mission24.Description: "&y&Demons&!& - they cross the river!##Ibzan feels the flame-#Hire help from beyond.#Demons are not dead#but die just the same." ##Ibzan is getting his car serviced at a nearby garage, defended by Demons. The return address to his home should be on the car.

map_demon.Name: Demons
map_demon.Description: Creatures from beyond Charon's river, they sometimes make their way up as hired mercenaries. The Candles nor my employer know how the skeletons are paying for their service.

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: Demons bring high-powered weaponry from their lands. I will have to be careful and use cover accordingly.

map_mission25.Name: Mission
map_mission25.Description: "His home is exposed.#Find the portal.#Prove him mortal.#Leave him decomposed." ##Ibzan's apartment must contain data about the &y&portal&!& The Dredged are planning to construct.

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: To help fight the Demon arsenal, Charon has lent us an extremely powerful weapon. I can find it in my car - I'll use it liberally.

map_portal.Name: portal
map_portal.Description: The "meat portal" Timur constructed must be destroyed - or the skeletons, and all the undead with them, could leave this Place.

map_mission26.Name: Mission
map_mission26.Description: I have found the location of the meat portal, but it is heavily defended by snipers. The &y&Candles&!& have offered their assistance, but I must first kill &y&Vall&!& - the best of the demon snipers.

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: To get a clear shot at Vall I will have to get on the roof of a nearby building... while avoiding her sniper fire.

map_candles.Name: Candles
map_candles.Description: The Candles never engage in combat - but our employer has made an exception.

map_vall.Name: Vall
map_vall.Description: "She paints with such glee!#A splattered canvas.#A woman of vision#cannot live with me."

map_mission27.Dialogue: The flames stay extinguished - but a voice still speaks.
map_mission27.Name: Mission
map_mission27.Description: "He cannot be free.#I cannot forgive.#A man - undead#cannot live with me."

map_intel.Name: Intel
map_intel.Description: The Candles will support from above - but they have limited ammunition. I will have to make sure I use their help conservatively.

map_mission28.Name: Mission
map_mission28.Description: The flames continue to crackle - it no longer has missions for me.
